page_title: NET 1-1 ECU | Netherlands v Ecuador 25/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+2' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) failed to beat the keeper. Andries Noppert expertly stopped his header from the edge of the box which he sent to the middle of the goal after a rebound.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Enner Valencia just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Kevin Rodriguez (Ecuador) replaces him.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Romario Ibarra (Ecuador) for Gonzalo Plata.
87' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
86' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
86' Referee Mustapha Ghorbal sees the trip by Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Netherlands are awarded the free kick.
85' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle for an infringement.
83' The attendance is 44833.
81' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
81' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

80' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Ecuador will have a corner.
79' Here is a change. Teun Koopmeiners is going off and Louis van Gaal gives the last tactical orders to Marten de Roon (Netherlands).
79' That will be all from Cody Gakpo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Wout Weghorst (Netherlands).
79' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
77' Mustapha Ghorbal interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jurrien Timber (Netherlands).
75' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
74' Gustavo Alfaro has decided to substitute Michael Estrada and he is replaced by Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador).
73' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
71' Poor challenge! Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is penalised for tripping and Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davy Klaassen departs the field of play to be replaced by Steven Berghuis (Netherlands).
67' Michael Estrada (Ecuador) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
66' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
64' Wow, what an escape. Michael Estrada (Ecuador) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
62' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:10.
58' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
58' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
58' Jhegson Mendez (Ecuador) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
57' Jhegson Mendez (Ecuador) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
57' Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle for a foul after Piero Hincapie (Ecuador) hacks down one of his opponents.
56' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) tries to find Angelo Preciado, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

54' Michael Estrada (Ecuador) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mustapha Ghorbal with no other option than to blow for a foul.
53' The resulting corner from Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
49' 1 - 1 Enner Valencia (Ecuador) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Pervis Estupinan shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.
47' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Louis van Gaal makes a switch. Memphis Depay (Netherlands) is coming on in place of Steven Bergwijn at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Mustapha Ghorbal has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
45+3' The ball goes out of play. Ecuador are awarded a corner kick.

45+2' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Daley Blind (Netherlands) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Hernan Galindez intercepts the ball.
43' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Piero Hincapie (Ecuador) trips an opposition player and Mustapha Ghorbal signals a foul.
38' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:1.
36' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) sends a cross into the box, but Andries Noppert comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) tries to find Cody Gakpo, but he puts too much power on the pass.
33' The linesman signals that Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
33' The corner from Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) is cleared away by the defence.
32' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Andries Noppert makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
31' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
30' Daley Blind (Netherlands) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Netherlands.
29' The foul by Michael Estrada (Ecuador) was seen by Mustapha Ghorbal who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
28' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Angelo Preciado (Ecuador). Ecuador win a corner.
26' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) commits a rough foul. Mustapha Ghorbal stops the game and makes a call.
25' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
24' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
23' Felix Torres (Ecuador) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
22' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A spell of possession for Netherlands in an attempt to control the game.
13' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

11' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mustapha Ghorbal blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
8' Jhegson Mendez (Ecuador) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

6' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
5' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' The game is interrupted now, Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Netherlands keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Ecuador will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mustapha Ghorbal.
